1.t: When the sun is put out

2.t: and when the stars fall down

3.t: and when the mountains are blown away

4.t: and when pregnant camels are left untended

5.t: and when wild beasts are gathered together

6.t: and when the seas are set on fire

7.t: and when the souls ˹and their bodies˺ are paired ˹once more˺

8.t: and when baby girls, buried alive, are asked

9.t: for what crime they were put to death

10.t: and when the records ˹of deeds˺ are laid open

11.t: and when the sky is stripped away

12.t: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up

13.t: and when Paradise is brought near—

14.t: ˹on that Day˺ each soul will know what ˹deeds˺ it has brought along

15.t: I do swear by the receding stars

17.t: and the night as it falls

18.t: and the day as it breaks

19.t: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the Word of ˹Allah delivered by Gabriel,˺ a noble messenger-angel

20.t: full of power, held in honour by the Lord of the Throne

22.t: And your fellow man is not insane

23.t: And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon

24.t: and he does not withhold ˹what is revealed to him of˺ the unseen

25.t: And this ˹Quran˺ is not the word of an outcast devil

26.t: So what ˹other˺ path would you take

27.t: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—

28.t: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way

29.t: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺, except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of all worlds
29.tr: Wa-maa tashaaa'oona illaaa ai yashaaa-'al laahu Rabbul 'Aalameen
